headline: Frontlines Convulse as Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the war enters day 257 with the strategic map still undecided. The heaviest fighting remains concentrated in six sectors that have recorded dozens of ownership flips in the past 24 hours. Godcrofts leads with 40 base changes, 54 Colonial and 71 Warden casualties and a surge of 137 new enlistments. Weathered Expanse follows with 35 flips, adding roughly 9,500 Colonial and 13,100 Warden losses while enlistments climb at 15 per hour. Stlican Shelf shows 32 flips, 3,200 Colonial and 3,000 Warden casualties and enlistments rising 25 per hour. Fishermans Row, though lower in casualties (13 Colonial, 11 Warden), logged 25 flips and 96 enlistments. Stonecradle recorded 12 flips, 3,500 Colonial and 5,100 Warden casualties with enlistments up 23 per hour. Linn Mercy added eight flips, 1,400 Colonial and 2,900 Warden casualties and 634 enlistments. Across these fronts casualty rates and enlistment trends are accelerating, while the majority of regions report no base movement and only modest incremental losses.
